packageRules.description: github-actions: pin SHAs and auto-merge after the 7-day quarantine. Per-manager automerge scope ensures a future manager activation (e.g. npm via a new package.json) does NOT inherit automerge. A digest-only repoint (SHA moves, version label unchanged) is blocked at PR time by scripts/check-pin-digest-provenance.sh in the lint-doc-invariants group.

Self-reference to local composite action pinned by SHA. Renovate's github-actions manager treats `owner/repo/path@sha` uniformly, so pinDigests above covers the bump path. This rule exists to document intent and to ensure the self-reference is not accidentally excluded by a future matcher.

Nix install URL: scoped automerge for the same reason as github-actions. The custom manager below extracts the version from the pinned Nix install URL. matchDepNames narrows this rule to 'nix'; every other custom-regex dependency in this file carries its own automerge rule below, so each scope stays explicit per dependency rather than blanket.

nixpkgs-unstable: weekly grouping (inherits the global Friday schedule) plus automerge once every required check passes. Wide tooling-layer blast across formatters and linters, so the required check set is what stands between the bump and main. renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml supplies the lockfile this manager cannot write and fails closed when the refresh would write outside the paths it may commit, which keeps a tree-reformatting bump red rather than merging it. Triage for fallout that surfaces after the bump lands: docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md.

NixOS/nixpkgs stable branch: automerge once every required check passes. Widest blast radius in the repo — runtime, tooling, and the image base layer all move with the YY.MM branch — and part of the fallout (formatter rewrites, new linter rules) surfaces on a later cron run or contributor PR rather than on this PR's own checks. Recovery for that case is a revert. renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml supplies the lockfile this manager cannot write; see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md for the triage tables.

cachix/git-hooks.nix master HEAD: automerge once every required check passes. renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml supplies the lockfile this manager cannot write; while flake.nix is ahead of flake.lock the flake-check job is red, so the PR cannot merge before the refresh lands.

SchemaStore/schemastore master HEAD: automerge once every required check passes. The pin feeds scripts/check-jsonschema.sh, which validates this repo's JSON and YAML against the bumped SHA in CI, so a schema set that rejects a tracked file keeps the PR red.

octoscan: scoped automerge for the same reason as github-actions — digest-pinned, 7-day quarantine catches obvious breakage. matchDepNames narrows this rule to the octoscan image so each custom-regex dependency keeps its own explicit automerge scope.

customManagers.description: cachix/git-hooks.nix master HEAD tracker. Uses git-refs datasource because that repo publishes 0 GitHub releases and 0 tags — master HEAD is the only upstream-truth signal. Renovate opens a PR whenever master advances; runs through the global 7-day minimumReleaseAge quarantine. This manager only substitutes the SHA in flake.nix; renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml runs `nix flake update pre-commit-hooks` on the PR branch and commits the refreshed flake.lock. Until that commit lands the PR is red and cannot merge. When the auto-refresh does not fire, an issue is filed under the renovate-flake-lock-refresh-failure label and the manual fallback is in docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md.

NixOS/nixpkgs stable branch tracker. Captures the YY.MM suffix of the nixos-YY.MM branch in flake.nix and watches NixOS/nixpkgs tags for new YY.MM tags (versioningTemplate restricts to MAJOR.MINOR form). NixOS tags only at GA, so this naturally proposes the next stable branch when it ships. This manager only substitutes the branch name in flake.nix; renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml runs `nix flake update nixpkgs` on the PR branch and commits the refreshed flake.lock, and the PR stays red until it does. Expect downstream side-effects (prettier, mkdocs-macros strictness, zizmor major version, image base-layer rotation) — see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md for the triage tables.

NixOS/nixpkgs-unstable rolling branch tracker. The branch name 'nixos-unstable' itself never changes; the actual movement is via flake.lock. This manager exists as a trigger for renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml (which runs `nix flake update nixpkgs-unstable` and commits the refreshed lockfile). git-refs datasource on the branch HEAD; weekly cadence inherits global schedule. This is the tooling-layer bump — expect formatter-output diffs (shfmt, prettier, mdformat, taplo, just, nixfmt) and new linter rules (zizmor, statix, deadnix, actionlint, shellcheck), all of which surface as red checks on the PR. No runtime regressions; linpeas-image stays on stable nixpkgs. See docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md.

SchemaStore master HEAD tracker for the JSON Schema URLs consumed by scripts/check-jsonschema.sh. Same shape as the cachix/git-hooks.nix manager — SchemaStore publishes 0 releases and 0 tags, master HEAD is the only upstream-truth signal. Renovate opens a PR whenever master advances; the global 7-day minimumReleaseAge applies. The bumped SHA is what check-jsonschema.sh validates against in CI, so a schema set that rejects a tracked file keeps the PR red.

octoscan container image pinned by digest in scripts/octoscan-scan.sh (single source of truth for the CI workflow and the pre-commit hook). The matchString spans both the OCTOSCAN_DIGEST and OCTOSCAN_VERSION shell vars so Renovate updates both atomically — no drift between digest and version label. Uses docker datasource; Renovate resolves the newest tag for ghcr.io/synacktiv/octoscan and substitutes both currentDigest + currentValue in one PR. Automerge is enabled via a scoped packageRule (matchDepNames narrow), matching the github-actions pattern (digest-pinned + 7-day quarantine). The `sha256:` prefix MUST stay inside the currentDigest capture group: the docker datasource reports digests prefixed, so capturing bare hex makes every run compare `<hex>` against `sha256:<hex>`, report an update for a digest that never moved, and open a PR that check-pin-digest-provenance.sh then hard-fails as a repointed released tag — a standing false supply-chain alarm.
